changelog:
- **The mobile app moves to Expo SDK 58** (#2976, epic #2775). Every Expo package moves together through `npx expo install --fix`: `expo` 58.0.16, `expo-router` 58.0.24, `expo-notifications` 58.1.5, React Native 0.88, React 19.3. That drops the `expo-router ~57.0.26` pin, added in #2848 after Dependabot's lone expo-router 58 bump (#2780) broke `npm ci`, and with expo-router 57's `query-string` 7 goes `decode-uri-component` 0.2.2, so GHSA-vcc3-ghjq-m6fr is closed in `apps/mobile` (`npm audit`: no new advisory; braces, node-forge and uuid stay inside Expo's own build tooling). The lockfile is regenerated: npm could not move the existing tree, because it still held expo-router 57's `@expo/ui` 57 against expo-router 58's optional peer `@expo/ui ^58`.
